title: Autopay Credit Against the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Refinance Down Payment
content:
On a balloon refinance of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, an autopay record earns a credit taken off the refinance down payment. The count is the balloon payments posted through the autopay ACH channel in the 12 calendar months ending on the payment date.

| Autopay payments posted in the 12 months | Taken off the refinance down payment |
|---|---|
| At least 10 | USD 100.00 |
| At least 6 but fewer than 10 | USD 50.00 |
| Fewer than 6 | None |

Payments through other channels are not counted. A window of 12 calendar months ending on the payment date takes in the dates on or before the payment date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.
